olivia: Kicking off a 1% live canary for rwd-v2.9-int4 on the seeded-legal-summaries cohort. Shadowed for ~30m, live at 1% for 45m. Posting quick A/B snapshot and concerns.

darshan: Can you paste the numbers (p95 / throughput / mrr / hallucination)?

olivia: Sure — quick snapshot (aggregate, longdocs = >2k tokens):
```
baseline (v2.8)    | canary (v2.9-int4)
p95 latency: 320ms  | 360ms
tokens/sec: 1200   | 1350
MRR (longdocs): 0.724 | 0.707 (-2.4%)
halluc rate (n=1k): 0.9% | 2.3%
```

kevin: :thinking: Hallucination jump on longdocs is the red flag. Is the regression concentrated on specific slices or spread?

olivia: Concentrated on contract_clause extraction and citations. Shortform/chat slices neutral or slightly positive.

darshan: eval-bot, what's the automated drift detector showing?

eval-bot: automated: ALERT — cohort=seeded-legal-summaries.contract_clause | mrr_delta = -2.4% (p=0.02) | halluc_rate_delta = +1.4pp | window=45m | action: early-warning triggered. Suggested immediate actions: hold promotion, increase shadow sample to 5k, run targeted rerun on 500 failing examples.

olivia: Current rollout config (snippet):
```
rollout:
  initial_percent: 1
  promote_if:
    duration: 2h
    mrr_delta_threshold: -1.5%
    halluc_delta_threshold: +1.0pp
  autofallback:
    enabled: true
    window: 1h
    sustained_delta: -1.0%
```
Note: autofallback hasn't triggered yet because the delta isn't sustained for the configured window.

kevin: Two options: tighten promote_if thresholds for longdoc cohorts (eg -0.5% / +0.5pp) or add a cohort-specific override for contract_clause. I prefer a cohort override.

darshan: Also worth trying KV warmup tweaks — int4 longctx often needs longer kv prefetch to avoid generation regressions. Ops could try kv_warmup_ms 300 -> 1500 for canary nodes.

leo: Kicked a kv_warmup job on the canary pool (1500ms). Starting a shadow sweep ~2k longdocs now; should have initial numbers in ~30m.

olivia: Plan: (1) pause any promotion, (2) apply cohort override tightening thresholds for seeded-legal-summaries.contract_clause, (3) run kv_warmup experiment + shadow sweep for 4h, (4) autofallback/rollback if mrr_delta remains > -1.5% for >=2h. I'll open a PR for the rollout config change.

darshan: Also add a pre-promote eval: 500 contract_clause examples must pass MRR/halluc thresholds before any scale-up. Add note to runbook: "int4 longdoc sensitivity".

kevin: sg. If infra confirms KV warmup reduces halluc delta, run a 0.5% follow-up test with the warmup enabled before broader roll.

olivia: Thanks — will update with infra numbers in ~30m. :thumbsup: :eyes:
